About Crawl Atlas

A reading companion for Dungeon Crawler Carl. Follow characters’ levels, stats, skills, and belongings as you read.

The books

All credit for this world and its characters goes to Matt Dinniman. Thanks for giving us Carl, Donut, and a dungeon worth keeping track of. Find the books →

Using the atlas

Set the slider to your place in the series. Charts and character records only show observations recorded up to that point. A shared link includes its reading position—check it before opening someone else’s link.

What the numbers mean

The dataset covers eight books, but extraction is incomplete. A gap means no measurement is recorded here, not that a stat stayed unchanged. Lines connect observations; they don’t establish when an increase happened.

Filled dots show recorded values. Open circles show estimates or lower bounds. Equipment and temporary bonuses are kept separate. History includes source locations and the reasoning behind estimates.

How it’s made

Built with dbt Charts using SQL, YAML, and a custom chart template, exported as static HTML and hosted on GitHub Pages. The reading slider selects a complete board export containing only observations up to that point. Explore the dbt Charts project →

Made by Anders Swanson. Browse the source or send feedback on GitHub.

Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with the author or publisher. The site publishes factual summaries, not the EPUBs, book text, or artwork.
